Pacing Calendar, 2026-27

Every B-day of the school year, mapped to its work. Built from the IBW Trivory calendar (trivory.com/ibw/calendar, read Sept 2026). The class meets on B days only; this calendar is the contract between the syllabus and the clock.

The shape: the year opens with two weeks of Scratch — a get-to-know-you starter project where you meet the building blocks (sprites, loops, events) with zero engine overhead. On Sep 14 the first Unity project begins: we build one real game — a 2D RPG that becomes a 2D platformer when you enter a cave — from the cs-curriculum-main starter repo, ending with your own boss fight and the semester final (a normal B day, Jan 21). Second semester: the CSP big ideas Unity cannot teach alone (data, systems, impact), then three game jams, with the Create performance task due2027-04-30 and the AP exam onFriday, May 14, 2027 at 8:00 AM (Session 1) (2027-05-14). The exam is an A-day Friday morning — you take it before school-day classes start. After it: Season 2 jams, for the love of the game.All 10 CED topic families are covered by the exam.

Calendar sources: IBW Trivory calendar (trivory.com/ibw/calendar, read Sept 2026) — 82 regular B days plus the Jan 21 finals B day, Sep 1-Jun 3. No-school days this year: Oct 9 + Oct 14, Veterans Day (Nov 11), Thanksgiving week (Nov 23-27), winter break (Dec 21-Jan 1), MLK Day (Jan 18), semester break (Jan 25-26), Presidents Day (Feb 15), Mar 3, spring break (Mar 22-26), Memorial Day (May 31). Snow days are not modeled; if one lands on a B day, shift work forward and let the placeholder jam days (Jun 1 + Jun 3) absorb it. June finals (Jun 4-8) carry no A/B label — the semester 2 final meets on this course's block during finals week.
